messages:
dana: Uploaded the RedTeamCo pen test report to /vault/reports/RT-2026-03.pdf. High-level: 4 high (RBAC elevation path, KMS key exposure via service principal, missing audit retention on S3, insecure presigned URL use), 6 medium, 12 low. Attaching vendor exec summary here.
mike: Thanks — quick Q: is the KMS finding about key policy or how we provision service identities? @lara any idea?
lara: KMS issue looks like a service account created during onboarding had overly permissive IAM -> could decrypt because key policy allowed project:serviceAccount:* . I can paste the snippet.
lara: ```
resource "google_kms_crypto_key_iam_binding" "insecure" {
  crypto_key_id = "projects/prod/locations/global/keyR"
  role = "roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter"
  members = ["serviceAccount:onboarding@proj.iam.gserviceaccount.com"]
}
```
lara: That binding shouldn't exist for onboarding SA — it was a template mistake when we imported old infra.
dana: Good catch. Vendor also flagged RBAC on the console where a support group had write on feature flags. That explains the privilege escalation path they exploited. Need owners.
kevin: I can take RBAC in console and feature-flag perms. I'll open a ticket and propose least-privilege mappings. Assign to me: SEC-4321.
olivia: I'll own the KMS remediation — will rotate keys and tighten the key policy, plus audit access. Assign SEC-4322 to me.
mike: I'll take the audit logging gaps (S3 retention / audit sinks). Quick mitigation: enable Object Lock retention for critical buckets and extend CloudTrail/Splunk retention. Will file SEC-4323.
triage-bot: New tickets created: SEC-4321 (RBAC), SEC-4322 (KMS), SEC-4323 (Audit logs). ETA fields required within 48h or escalate to manager.
dana: We need a retest window with RedTeamCo. They offered next-week slots: Tue 09:00-12:00 or Thu 13:00-17:00 (UTC). Which works for infra and sec? @lara @olivia @mike
lara: Tue morning works for infra. Prefer earlier so we can cutover fixes Mon night.
olivia: Tue is OK for me.
mike: Tue OK. Kevin?@kevin
kevin: Tue morning works.
dana: Great — I'll lock Tue 09:00-12:00 UTC with vendor. Two asks before retest: 1) document temporary mitigation steps in each ticket, 2) provide evidence artifacts (policy diffs, rotated key IDs, audit config screenshots). Keep replies short in tickets with links.
kevin: For RBAC fix I'll provide a before/after policy diff and the scripts to apply in staging. Example command I'll include:
kevin: ```
gcloud projects get-iam-policy prod --flatten="bindings[]"
# then apply minimal binding via iam roles
```
olivia: For KMS rotate: I'll run keyVersionDestroy on the old key and create a new crypto key, then update services. Will produce a list of impacted services and a key rotation playbook.
dana: One more: vendor highlighted that presigned URLs lack expiration enforcement for one upload flow. Can the app team patch ASAP? @mike can you route to product?
mike: I'll ping the app-sdks channel and open a child ticket for the uploads flow. Will add a code snippet suggestion (enforce 15m expirations + signed headers).
kevin: Also noticed vendor used automated scanning to find the S3 presigned flows. We should add a WAF rule to throttle those endpoints as interim mitigation.
lara: Ops note: We'll run the infra changes in staging Thu night and do a smoke deploy Fri morning. If smoke passes, push to prod Mon 02:00 UTC.
dana: Can everyone add ETA into the ticket comments by EOD today? Vendor needs confirmation 48h before retest.
kevin: Done — added SEC-4321 comment with ETA Mon 02:00 UTC for RBAC locks.
olivia: Added SEC-4322 with rotation plan and listed service owners.
mike: SEC-4323 updated with retention policy changes and S3 Object Lock plan.
dana: Thanks. I'll create a consolidated audit folder with evidence links: /vault/reports/RT-2026-03/evidence/. Please upload screenshots/logs there.
kevin: Question — for verification, does RedTeamCo require full replay logs or just policy screenshots + cloudtrail ranges?
dana: They asked for CloudTrail ranges and sample request IDs for the exploit timeframe, plus policy screenshots. No full replay needed.
triage-bot: Reminder: if any ticket ETA slips, tag manager @anna and mark P1 for followup.
olivia: Heads-up: key rotation will cause a brief deploy break for the legacy onboarding service; I'll coordinate with app team for a migration window.
mike: Noted. We'll feature-flag fallback and monitor errors during rotation.
dana: OK team — locking vendor retest Tue 09:00-12:00 UTC. We'll run readiness checklist Mon 20:00 UTC. I'll post checklist tomorrow AM. :white_check_mark:
kevin: Thanks — will prepare RBAC playbook.
lara: I'll prepare infra runbook and test plan.
olivia: Preparing key rotation playbook and test vectors.
mike: Routing upload fix to app-sdks and enabling temporary WAF rule.
dana: Closing thread for now; reopen if blockers. If anyone needs help drafting evidence, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
